answer: A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The umber counter is kept in meadow and summit makes public each reset. Someone thus has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 2323 identities would post 3795 proofs and burn roughly 21 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
